title: GMI technology economic-change evidence envelope v1 (technology_economic_change.evidence.v1)
description: Closed evidence envelope for the Technology ex-Semis company-first research profile (T8A, macro#7891; proposed §8 shape @ 382c0b399d5c on #7870, under Sol adjudication). Exactly ONE authorized, already-accepted shared curation assertion, deep-copied from the owner bundle with exactly one key excluded: its assertion-internal authority block — the envelope states the six-false authority ceiling once, at its own top level, and forbids a second authority surface inside the open assertion object; otherwise its internal shape is owned by theme_graph.curation_assertion.v1 (macro#7870) and is deliberately the only open object here. The generation is the dossier_id of the composed dossier that actually rendered the citing row/card/counter, so the envelope can never cite a projection it was not selected from. Unknown and not-selected references share one refusal code, so the envelope discloses no existence. Authority ceiling research_display_only: all six flags literally false (ECD-48); this envelope ranks, gates, sizes, vetoes, originates and opens nothing.

generation.description: The dossier_id grammar of technology_economic_change.v1: the composed dossier that rendered the citing row/card/counter.

assertion.description: Deep copy of the one authorized assertion, verbatim except for exactly one excluded key: the assertion-internal authority block (the envelope's own top-level authority section is the single authority statement, so a smuggled second one — all-true flags, rank, sizing — can never validate). Otherwise open on purpose: the shared assertion contract (theme_graph.curation_assertion.v1) owns this shape; restating it here would fork the shared contract.

limitations.description: Sorted dossier-level limitation texts relevant to the cited content; may be empty when the composed dossier carries none. Explicitly bounded (today the dossier contract carries exactly one comparison primary limitation): an unbounded list never validates, and nothing is truncated to fit.
